name: Python Tools
description: A GridCraft plugin written in Python: statistics, regular expressions and text clean-up. Needs python3.
author: Marco Montanari

functions.name: PY.TWICE
functions.description: Doubles a number, or each number of a range

functions.name: PY.MEDIAN
functions.description: Median, computed by Python's statistics module

functions.name: PY.STATS
functions.description: A spilled table: count, sum, mean, median, min, max, stdev

functions.name: PY.REGEX
functions.description: The first match of a Python regular expression, or #N/A

functions.name: PY.SPLIT
functions.description: Splits text into a spilled row (default: on whitespace)

commands.label: Title Case
commands.description: Title-cases the text in the selection

commands.label: Trim Spaces
commands.description: Removes extra spaces from the text in the selection

commands.label: Statistics
commands.description: Writes a statistics table to the right of the selection

commands.label: Fibonacci
commands.description: Fills the Fibonacci numbers down from the active cell
